7424577bc319.source: The waitress soon returns with the apple salad and water causing them to be excited.

38881815e325.replacementExpression: "Quando tenta reclamar, a mulher segura seu braço."

a18d5dfc8036.source: * Complaining isn’t going to do anything, you have to stop worrying about Libitina.

8d3081e3eabc.source: * Just enjoy your meal, that’s the only way your visit to this place is worth a damn!

21defab59e66.source: She explains to them with an authoritarian voice.
21defab59e66.originalExpression: "She explains to them with an authoritarian voice."

4409799b6836.source: They stop eating as the words dwell on them.

fb8b4f3a206f.originalExpression: "They turn around and see the cold and emotionless expression of Libitina."

9bf3da2cffb4.replacementExpression: "* Deixe-me só terminar minha água, certo?"

a39a56f30ede.source: They gently say before finishing the water in one motion and getting up.

a39a56f30ede.originalExpression: "They gently say before finishing the water in one motion and getting up."
a39a56f30ede.replacementExpression: "Diz gentilmente antes de terminar a água de uma vez e se levantar."

2ad3eeba9f65.source: So that Libitina can guide them to the exit.

57e9f5b8966a.source: They look at the pale sky and they move on...

57e9f5b8966a.replacementExpression: "Olha para o céu pálido e segue adiante..."

4b1de1511600.source: Hoping that there is another place but not minding if this is the end.
4b1de1511600.translation: Con la esperanza de que haya otro lugar, pero sin importarle si este es el final.
4b1de1511600.originalExpression: "Hoping that there is another place but not minding if this is the end."
4b1de1511600.replacementExpression: "Esperando que exista outro lugar, mas sem se importar caso este seja o fim."

5c5939e282df.source: No matter what lies ahead, they got to enjoy the food they had.

5c5939e282df.originalExpression: "No matter what lies ahead, they got to enjoy the food they had."
5c5939e282df.replacementExpression: "Não importa o que exista adiante, pôde aproveitar a comida que teve."

0eec4f69ca2a.source: * Thank you for listening to my story.
0eec4f69ca2a.originalExpression: "* Thank you for listening to my story."

ec2a27ac6a09.source: * It was certainly an interesting story.
ec2a27ac6a09.translation: * Sin duda fue una historia interesante.
ec2a27ac6a09.originalExpression: "* It was certainly an interesting story."

307e5ea8efb8.replacementExpression: "* Existe algum motivo específico para você querer contar essa história?"

1cc22718f05f.replacementExpression: "* Bem... Vocês três agem conforme a vontade de Libitina, não é?"

0a1a8d6d13ed.source: * You seal fountains to let others live...

0a1a8d6d13ed.replacementExpression: "* Vocês selam Fontes para que outros possam viver..."

df23485709e2.source: * Well... I am going to visit it eventually...

df23485709e2.originalExpression: "* Well... I am going to visit it eventually..."

78e9c8334d58.source: * I am the Libitina, after all...

78e9c8334d58.originalExpression: "* I am the Libitina, after all..."

403eba10f250.source: * So... does this mean something bad?
